From: Sophie Lang <sophie.lang@acme.com>

Cc: Mike Broker <mike.broker@brokersinc.com>
Date: 2028-11-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Insurance evidence for Redwood MSA & Order Form — entity naming & umbrella ask

Hi Jonas,

Quick note from Acme Legal & Procurement — as part of finalizing the Order Form we need certificates and endorsements that meet the below requirements. Please confirm whether Redwood can provide these or if you prefer Acme to accept alternative language.

Required evidence:
- Commercial General Liability: $1,000,000 each occurrence / $2,000,000 aggregate
- Auto Liability: $1,000,000 combined single limit
- Umbrella: $5,000,000 (carrier endorsement to follow)
- Cyber/Privacy: $5,000,000
- Additional insured: Acme Technologies, Inc. AND Acme Holdings Ltd. (both entities must appear on COI and endorsement where available)
- Primary and non-contributory wording on GL/Auto; waiver of subrogation on GL/Auto
- If endorsement cannot name Holdings Ltd, a COI naming both entities plus confirmation from broker that endorsement will be issued for Acme Technologies, Inc. is acceptable

Attached is our certificate template for reference. Also flagging that Acme prefers the policy number on the COI to validate scope, but we can accept a redacted number if carrier policy prevents sharing.

Order Form reference: OF-ACME-0923

Thanks — can you turn around by end of day Thursday?

Attachments: Acme_Certificate_Template.pdf (pdf)

Best,
Sophie Lang
Senior Contracts Manager
Acme Technologies

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com <jonas_weber@redwood.com>

Date: 2028-11-01T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Insurance evidence for Redwood MSA & Order Form — entity naming & umbrella ask

Forwarding Acme's request — see attached template.

Quick thoughts:
- Acme is asking for two named entities (Tech Inc. + Holdings Ltd). Holdings is a non-operating parent; we typically limit endorsements to operating entities.
- Proposal: provide COI that lists both entities, and secure an endorsement naming Acme Technologies, Inc. as additional insured. That meets Acme's audit requirement while limiting exposure.
- Confirm whether umbrella can count toward aggregate requirement; legal to confirm whether we should accept umbrella as satisfying the aggregate.

Kimberly / Aditya — can you:
1) Confirm legal stance on naming Holdings Ltd as an additional insured on the endorsement?
2) Confirm acceptance of COI + limited endorsement compromise?
3) Advise on primary/non-contributory + waiver of subrogation scope (which lines we can commit to)

If we need to push for full endorsement naming both entities, who will own the escalation to Acme's broker? Mike Broker is CC'd.

Thanks,
Jonas
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2028-11-01T10:22:00-08:00
Subject: Action: redline guidance for OF-ACME-0923 (insurance)

Aditya — forwarding the request with a proposed compromise for legal redline. Please see inline suggestions (quick bullets):

- COI: Redwood will provide certificate showing required limits and listing both Acme Technologies, Inc. and Acme Holdings Ltd. as certificate holders/insureds.
- Endorsement: Redwood will obtain an additional insured endorsement for Acme Technologies, Inc. only (insurer permitting). If the insurer refuses to endorse Holdings Ltd, we'll provide written confirmation from the broker.
- Primary/non-contributory: we can accept "primary and non-contributory" for GL and Auto lines where carrier accepts — include on endorsement and COI as appropriate.
- Waiver of subrogation: accept on GL/Auto only (not obligating cyber underwriters).
- Umbrella: allow umbrella to satisfy the aggregate requirement provided the carrier confirms the umbrella follows form and provides equivalent cover for the listed limits.

Timebox: Acme asked for turnaround by COB Thu (11/02).

Related links: DocuSign order form (pending): https://docusign.com/r/xyz-envelope-1234
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deal/ACME-0923

If legal signs off, I'll respond to Acme and loop broker.

Thanks,
Jonas

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2028-11-01T13:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Action: redline guidance for OF-ACME-0923 (insurance)

Jonas / team — legal has reviewed. Recommended redline language and guidance below. Please circulate back to Acme (copy broker) with these bullets.

1) Naming: We are comfortable providing a COI that lists both Acme Technologies, Inc. and Acme Holdings Ltd. as certificate holders. However, for the additional insured endorsement we should limit the endorsement to the operational entity (Acme Technologies, Inc.) unless Acme provides corporate documentation demonstrating Holdings Ltd is on-the-hook for the contract. That is our preferred compromise.

2) Primary & Non-Contributory / Waiver of Subrogation: We can accept primary and non-contributory and waiver of subrogation on Commercial GL and Auto. Do NOT accept across Cyber at this time (cyber markets typically decline blanket subrogation waivers).

3) Umbrella / Aggregate: Accepting umbrella limits to satisfy the aggregate is acceptable if and only if the umbrella endorsement states "follows form" to the underlying GL/Auto and the umbrella carrier confirms scope by endorsement language. Ask broker to provide a carrier statement.

4) Policy Number: We prefer policy numbers to appear on COIs for audit purposes. If the carrier cannot provide policy numbers, we can accept redacted policy numbers but require a broker attestation that the policy exists and meets the stated scope.

5) Deliverables & timeline: Request from Acme/Broker: (a) COI naming both entities; (b) AI endorsement for Acme Technologies, Inc.; (c) carrier letter if umbrella is to count; (d) confirmation on policy number redaction (if relevant).

Proposed redline snippet for Order Form / MSA insurance exhibit (one-liner):
"Seller shall provide a Certificate of Insurance naming the entity(ies) listed on the Order Form as certificate holders. Additional insured endorsements will be provided to Acme Technologies, Inc. where available. Umbrella limits may be used to satisfy aggregate requirements provided the umbrella follows form to the underlying coverages."

If you want legal to put a formal redline on the MSA/Order Form exhibit I can produce a tracked-changes version by tomorrow morning.

—Aditya
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

- The carrier will provide an additional insured endorsement for Acme Technologies, Inc. only; broker will provide a written attestation confirming why Holdings Ltd cannot be listed on the endorsement (corporate structure).
- Umbrella carrier confirmed "follows form" and will issue a short carrier letter confirming scope so umbrella can be counted toward the aggregate.
- Policy numbers: carrier will provide policy numbers on the COI (not redacted) — attaching the initial COI for your review.

We are comfortable moving forward with the DocuSign order form once you confirm the above.
